summary: POET Technologies filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing board changes effective August 1, 2026. Dr. Bardia Pezeshki and Jean F. Rankin were appointed to the board, and long-serving director Jean-Louis Malinge resigned for personal reasons. The appointments fill vacancies and add expertise in optical communications and governance. No deal terms, prices, or advisor details were disclosed. The filing is a routine board composition update, not a special-situation transaction. What to watch: any strategic shifts following the new directors' contributions and whether further management changes occur.
